name: team_task_create
description: Create one unowned pending task on the shared Team task board. Any member of a subagent tree can add a task; blockers must be existing task ids and write scopes are advisory workspace-relative prefixes.

description.description: Complete task details and acceptance criteria.

blocked_by.description: Task ids that must complete first.

write_scopes.description: Advisory file or directory prefixes relative to the workspace root; no absolute paths or ".." segments. Omit or pass [] if no workspace files will be modified.

prompt: Team shared task board: create, read, list, and compare-and-set tasks across the subagent tree. Claim a ready task with its current revision, do the work, then complete it. Dependencies gate claims; write scopes are advisory, not a lock.
